item.title: Creamy Zucchini Penne
item.description:
Ingredients

  • One zucchini
  • Garlic
  • One lemon
  • Italian seasoning
  • Penne
  • Cream cheese
  • Chicken stock
  • Parmesan

Instructions

Cook Penne

Bake zucchini at 450F with oil and italian seasoning

Prepare Sauce

  1. Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a saucepan.
  2. Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant.
  3. Stir in cream cheese, chicken stock, grated Parmesan, and pasta water.
  4. Season with salt and pepper.

Combine and Serve

item.title: Sweet Umami Beef Bowl
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 200g White rice
  • 330g Ground beef
  • 330g Carrots
  • 330g cucumber
  • Sriracha
  • Ponzu sauce
  • Lime
  • Onion
  • Scallions

Notes

This recipe made approximately 3 servings.

beef:carrot:cucumber:rice ratio is approximately 1:1:1:2

Instructions

Rice

  • Cook rice with a pinch of salt.
  • Add 1 tbsp butter, scallion greens, and lime zest.

Cucumber

  • Slice cucumber into slim half moons.
  • In a sealable tupperware, combine cucumber, juice from 1/2 lime, 1/4 tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt.
  • Shake frequently to pickle.

Carrots

  • Grate or julienne carrots for desired texture.

Beef

  • Cook diced onion and scallion whites in a pan.
  • Add beef, garlic, and 2 tsp sugar. Cook until the beef is browned.
  • Add ponzu sauce, salt, and pepper to taste.

Topping

  • Mix 2 tsp mayo with a squeeze of lime juice, a pinch of garlic, sriracha, salt, and pepper for a delicious topping.

Combine and serve

item.title: Blanched Asparagus
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Asparagus

Extras

  • Bowl of ice water

Instructions

Prepare Asparagus

  • Cut woody base off
  • Peel base for even thickness

Cook Asparagus

  • Bring salty water to a boil
  • Place asparagus in
  • Cook for 1 to 4 minutes depending on desired doneness
  • Remove and place into ice water
  • Dry with a towel

Sear Asparagus

  • Bring buttered pan to medium heat
  • Asparagus in
  • Add salt, pepper, butter, garlic
  • Roll around until desired color forms on asparagus
  • Remove and serve

item.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 2 cups heavy whipping cream
  • 1/2 cups fresh grated parmesan
  • Fettuccine

Instructions

Cook Alfredo

Make Sauce

  • Pour cream into a pan and bring to simmer
  • Slowly combine parmesan until combined
  • Continue to simmer until desired thickness
  • Combine pasta
  • Serve

item.title: Ham and Cheese Crepes
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Crepes (see Savory Crepes Recipe)
  • Ham
  • Cheese (many kinds work well)

Instructions

Prepare Ingredients

Cut ham and cheese into cubes.

Create Savory Crepes

Create savory crepes as seen in the Savory Crepes Recipe

Assemble Crepes

Load half the crepe with ham and cheese, then roll it up.

Cook Crepes

Place the rolled-up crepe into a hot buttered pan with the end of the crepe on the bottom. Cook until the cheese melts and the crepe browns slightly. Flip and do the same on the other side.
